changes.note: The seeded loop now covers every row-level-secured table, including reference_alerts_v1. Alerts are row-level secured although listed for scope review, so one owner-tenant alert is seeded through the ordinary alert store and asserted populated. New column-only check: every login whose duty is a column-only read on a row-level-secured table (at least session_reader and owner_reader on reference_identities_v1; monitor_ingress on clearances where present) sees no other tenant's row through its readable columns. The owner's identities are present, so zero means isolation, not an empty table. The remaining SCOPE_REVIEW stores (pack_lifecycle, governance rosters, governance fences, monitor heartbeats) stay OPEN and are not claimed. Found while running: reference_alerts_v1 is scoped by app.alert_tenant, not app.tenant, so the earlier loop's zero for alerts was vacuous; the count helper now sets both settings. The fixture exposes its existing alert store (additive field alerts=alerts).

After each Education, Health and product lawful decision: the application's own ReferenceDecisionRecorder refuses a record stamped before its durable evidence head (no entry added, chain verified). Its single floor-bound DurableClock, shared with the target authority, refuses a same-domain sample below the floor that application's decisions advanced (ordinary regressing source on the application's own floor row).
